scope: Existing 0029 revalidation and review of PR627/628; not a new defect report.
findings: The destination rescheduleKillAboveMI still requires LiveIntervals and permits hoisting a kill-copy into a physical register above a folded load; it still lacks the 0029 register-class availability guard.
The pass is named two-address-instruction at this revision. Old reproduction commands must be adapted without altering the MIR function bodies.
The experimental pipeline runs conventional SSA, imaginary spilling, imaginary assignment, and the still-unimplemented hardware MOSRegAlloc in order. The default remains conventional allocation.

MOSImagRegSpill rejects functions other than one successor-free block, physical imaginary live-ins, calls/regmasks, and virtual undef/tied/subregister/early-clobber inputs. Its generated transfers introduce the scratch and subregister cases handled by PR628.
No downstream implementation of MOSInterferenceGraph or MOSImagRegAssign was found in the active patch bundle. The 0002 search hit is only an initialization context line, not another implementation.
The preserved October 10 baseline binary reproduces the retained IR register-exhaustion signature; its original hash matches the historical record.
